question: Identify the tone of the passage.
solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The tone "**cautionary**" means giving advice or a warning. (चेतावनी देना)
 
• The passage advises readers to research and consult with healthcare professionals before using herbal remedies and warns that not all herbs are safe.
 
• The other options: **"populist," "pedestrian," and "sarcastic" do not fit the context as appropriately.**

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Populist (लोकलुभावन)**: means appealing to the interests or concerns of ordinary people.
 
• **Pedestrian (साधारण)**: means lacking inspiration or excitement; dull.
 
• **Sarcastic (व्यंग्यपूर्ण)**: meaning using irony to mock or convey contempt.
